extension_ids: P-V3 realized five-seed mean practical target

reference.escalation: none; retain and mark reference-precision inconclusive if CI half-width > practical_target/2
reference.quantile: NumPy inverted_cdf, global sorted scalar losses; no batch quantiles
reference.construction: explicit rho/sqrt(1-rho^2) for two assets; identity for five; no production Cholesky
reference.valuation: q*S0*exp annual GBM, V0-sum(VT), float64; no production helpers

practical_rule: For each realized five-seed mean m and reference quantile CI [L,U], pass if max(abs(m-L),abs(m-U)) <= .0005*V0; fail if distance(m,[L,U]) > target; otherwise inconclusive. Excess reference CI half-width forces inconclusive. Confirmatory criterion at N=10000000, smaller N diagnostic. Not population mean equivalence.
consistency_rule: F(qhat)~Beta(k,N+1-k), k=ceil(alpha*N). Per-comparison tail .005/(2*270). Reference empirical F(qhat) must lie within beta central bounds expanded by uniform DKW epsilon sqrt(log(2/(.0025/3))/(2*M)). Outside means rejected; inside means not rejected, not proof of equivalence. Any rejected seed prevents group consistency pass.

benchmark.order: fixture order as listed, N ascending, all warm-up rounds then measured; reverse config order on odd zero-based rounds, rotate left by (3*round)%7
benchmark.process: fresh owned suspended CLI process, fresh CUDA context; full allowed CPU pool, NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS, OS worker scheduling; no per-core pinning
benchmark.timer: engine end_to_end_ms; includes allocation/native RNG/correlated GBM/portfolio loss/global quantile/transfers/synchronization/cleanup and context work inside engine; excludes process startup, parsing, Cholesky, output, launcher telemetry and fixed delay
benchmark.power: require AC-line status, battery saver and active scheme unchanged versus initial inventory; battery percent retained but not a filter; no settings changes; unmeasured physical conditions unknown
benchmark.target: no portfolio speedup threshold; Tserial/Tconfig and TbestOpenMP/Tconfig each fixture/N

failure_policy.outliers: retain all successful measured samples; no value-based exclusions
failure_policy.interruption: stop and preserve full attempt; at most one complete replacement attempt in a NEW directory with reason, never cherry-pick replacements
failure_policy.reference_failure: retain partial attempt; do not shrink N or fabricate precision
failure_policy.sequential: reference, validation, benchmark run serially; no competing reference/profiling/sanitizer work during benchmark

pilot: none; all declared reference and validation results confirmatory
limits: Finite synthetic fixtures only, PRNG ideal-iid modeling assumption; no universal convergence, market prediction, advisor approval or academic submission; existing FR/NFR unchanged.
